text: 特朗普承诺若共和党赢得中期选举将给全国民众每人发放5000美元，这在美国30年期国债拍卖前给债券市场注入了新的不确定性，重新引发了对美国财政纪律和决策反复无常的担忧。在特朗普作出承诺后，美债收益率在窄幅区间内波动。特朗普对此并未提供细节，该提议预计不太可能成为法律。特朗普发表上述言论之际，30年期美债收益率正接近全球金融危机以来最高水平。此前美政府计划单次购买最多60亿美元较长期国债，令部分市场投资者感到失望。目前所有目光都集中在周四将发行的220亿美元2056年到期国债，以及本周晚些时候公布的CPI数据上。
text_en: Trump promised that if Republicans win the midterm elections he will give $5,000 to every person in the country, injecting new uncertainty into the bond market before the U.S. 30-year Treasury auction and reigniting concerns about U.S. fiscal discipline and erratic decision-making. After Trump made the promise, U.S. Treasury yields fluctuated within a narrow range. Trump did not provide details, and the proposal is expected to be unlikely to become law. Trump's remarks came as the 30-year U.S. Treasury yield is approaching its highest level since the global financial crisis. Previously, the U.S. government's plan to purchase up to $6 billion of longer-term Treasuries in a single operation disappointed some market investors. Currently, all eyes are on the $22 billion of Treasury bonds maturing in 2056 to be issued on Thursday, as well as CPI data to be released later this week.
